lesson.series: Learn Chinese with 家有儿女
lesson.title: 来，宝贝 — Morning F4 Chat

dialogue.speaker: xiaoyu
dialogue.english: Come on, sweetie, drink some milk.
dialogue.notes: 来 (lái) softens commands. 宝贝 is affectionate.

dialogue.speaker: xiaoxue
dialogue.chinese: 阿姨，你喜欢 F4 吗？
dialogue.notes: F4 = famous Taiwanese boy band. 阿姨 = polite term for stepmother.

dialogue.speaker: liumei
dialogue.notes: 呢 (ne) adds a casual, affirming tone.

dialogue.speaker: xiaoxue
dialogue.chinese: 那您觉得 F4 帅吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Nà nín juéde F4 shuài ma?
dialogue.english: Do you think F4 are handsome?
dialogue.notes: 您 = polite you. Sets up Liu Mei's joke.

scenes.sourceAsset: assets/source/00m16s_006_我觉得他们的直忆2的都帅.jpg

dialogue.speaker: liumei
dialogue.chinese: 我觉得吧，他们比 F1、F2、F3 都帅。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ juéde ba, tāmen bǐ F1, F2, F3 dōu shuài.
dialogue.english: I think they're even handsomer than F1, F2, and F3.
dialogue.grammar: 比 comparison: A 比 B + adjective
dialogue.notes: The joke: Liu Mei thinks F4 is numbered F1–F4. She doesn't realize F4 is the band name.

dialogue.speaker: liumei
dialogue.pinyin: Nà dōu shì xiē lǎo yuèduì.

dialogue.speaker: xiaoxue
dialogue.chinese: 阿姨，您对流行音乐的历史还真有研究。
dialogue.pinyin: Āyí, nín duì liúxíng yīnyuè de lìshǐ hái zhēn yǒu yánjiū.
dialogue.english: Auntie, you really know your pop music history.
dialogue.notes: 您 = polite you. 有研究 = know a lot about (colloquial praise).

dialogue.speaker: liumei
dialogue.chinese: 那当然了，阿姨是老追星族。
dialogue.pinyin: Nà dāngrán le, āyí shì lǎo zhuīxīngzú.
dialogue.english: Of course! Auntie is an old-school fan.

dialogue.speaker: xiaoxue
dialogue.chinese: 阿姨，那您喜欢哪首歌呀？
dialogue.pinyin: Āyí, nà nín xǐhuān nǎ shǒu gē ya?
dialogue.english: Auntie, which song do you like?

dialogue.speaker: xiaoxue
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān nà shǒu «Yào Dìng Nǐ».
dialogue.english: I like that song 'Want You for Sure.'

dialogue.speaker: liumei
dialogue.notes: 这首 = this song (首 measure word).

dialogue.speaker: xiadonghai
dialogue.chinese: 你们俩还有点臭味相投啊。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐmen liǎ hái yǒudiǎn chòuwèixiāngtóu a.
dialogue.english: You two really are birds of a feather!

dialogue.speaker: liumei
dialogue.notes: 那当然了 = natural agreement phrase.

dialogue.speaker: liumei
dialogue.chinese: 这叫不像一家人，不进一家门。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhè jiào bù xiàng yī jiā rén, bù jìn yī jiā mén.
dialogue.english: That's what they mean — like attracts like!
dialogue.idiom: 不是一家人，不进一家门
dialogue.notes: Classic chengyu about shared traits; Liu Mei uses 不像 playfully.

scenes.sourceAsset: assets/source/01m10s_025_那第亠 句词是什么来着.jpg

dialogue.speaker: xiaoxue
dialogue.pinyin: Āyí, nà nín chàng liǎng jù.
dialogue.english: Auntie, sing a couple lines for us!
dialogue.notes: 唱两句 = sing a bit (句 = lines/clauses).

dialogue.speaker: liumei
dialogue.chinese: 那第一句词是什么来着？
dialogue.pinyin: Nà dì yī jù cí shì shénme láizhe?
dialogue.english: What were the first lyrics again?

dialogue.speaker: liumei
dialogue.chinese: 我是骚动，我是爱情的暴风。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ shì sāodòng, wǒ shì àiqíng de bàofēng.
dialogue.english: I am the commotion, I am the storm of love.
dialogue.notes: Liu Mei botches F4 lyrics — comedy beat.

dialogue.speaker: liumei
dialogue.english: Love taking the lead, don't like being passive!

idioms.english: birds of a feather (share the same tastes)

idioms.chinese: 不是一家人，不进一家门
idioms.pinyin: bù shì yī jiā rén, bù jìn yī jiā mén
idioms.english: like attracts like; people of the same kind stick together
idioms.literal: if you're not family, you don't enter the same door

grammar.pattern: A 比 B 都 + Adj
grammar.meaning: A is even more [adj] than B
grammar.examplePinyin: Tāmen bǐ F1, F2, F3 dōu shuài
grammar.exampleEnglish: They're even handsomer than F1, F2, and F3

grammar.meaning: really do have / really know about

recapQuiz.question: What does 阿姨 mean in this episode?
recapQuiz.answer: A polite term Xiaoxue uses for her stepmother Liu Mei

recapQuiz.question: What does 臭味相投 mean?
recapQuiz.answer: Birds of a feather — people who share the same tastes

recapQuiz.question: Fill in: 他们 ___ F1、F2、F3 都帅
What measure word is used for songs?
